newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Russ Berrie Q2 net jumps with gain.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Russ Berrie Q2 net jumps with gain.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTES: The operating per-share figure for three-month period of 1997 excludes a provision of $1,500,000 to close all remaining retail operations. The operating per-share figure after the provision was reduced by $0.04 to $0.22 per share. The current three-month period reflects a loss of $1,065,000, or $0.05 per share, from discontinued operations. The net per-share figure in the current three- and six-month periods reflect, and a gain of $46.7 million, or $2.12 per share, from the sale of discontinued operations.
The current six-month period includes a total reduction in per-share net income of $0.06 from discontinued operations.

The prior three-month period's per-share net income figure includes a gain of $0.02 per share from discontinued operations. The prior six-month period's per-share net income figure includes a total gain of $0.05 per share from discontinued operations.
